nostr:
Amethyst 1.15.2 can fetch nested comments before you open the thread.

NIP-22 kind 1111 uses E/A for the root and e/a for the direct parent. PR #4095 adds separate root filters and puts NIP-34 kind 1619 updates under E.

A reply can be on the relay and still miss your query.

We track these client changes. Does your reply loader ask for the conversation root, or only its first level?

One filter containing both conditions would require both to match. Separate filters matter. Relay coverage and time bounds still limit the result; availability is verified through the GitHub release.
